    Product Details

    Take on any terrain with these men's Salomon XT-6 trainers, built for performance running and outdoor adventures. Designed for stability and durability, they’re perfect for trail runs or all-day exploring. The technical upper provides support, while the rugged outsole grips uneven ground with ease. Finished in a white colourway with black and turquoise accents, they combine outdoor function with street-ready style.

    • Durable synthetic and textile upper
    • Quicklace system for easy adjustment
    • EVA cushioning for comfort
    • Contagrip outsole for traction
    • White colourway with black and turquoise accents

    Colour: White

    Style Code: L49143300

    Product Code: 120733321

    Delivery & Returns

    Delivery

    Free delivery on orders over $150, $10 for orders less than $150. 

    Standard delivery takes 3-7 days, simply enter your address at checkout to get an estimated arrival date. For more delivery info visit our FAQs page. 

    Returns & Exchanges

    Free delivery or exchange at any JD Sports store within 30 days. Returns can also be sent via our returns portal for $10.95 via New Zealand Post. Some exclusions apply, for more details visit our returns FAQs.

    Please note:
    The following items are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged, unless faulty: sports bras, undergarments, socks and swimwear.
